source: head -c 16 /dev/urandom (validator's container), drawn after the E32 results commit 8afc92781b and before any replay run
rule:
at each size p the replayed index-calculus curve is seed s_p = 1 + (U mod 3), U = the first 64 bits (big-endian, unsigned) of SHA-256 of the ASCII string ':
